recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The current core source is correct; any remaining HL7 v2 value set URI presentation belongs to HL7 Terminology/THO rather than to the core Value Sets page.
issue_request: FHIR-26836 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the old Terminologies > Value Sets > HL7 V2 tab use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2- for value set URI prefixes instead of http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-*/*.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-26836 was found. The relevant source was implicitly superseded by 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8, which removed the HL7 v2 and HL7 v3 value-set tabs and the v2VSIndex placeholder from source/terminologies-valuesets.html while moving UTG content out of the core build; c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 carried that tabless page into the first R4B draft.
additional_context: The seed Jira comment says the typo was no longer relevant because R4B would point to terminology.hl7.org. FHIR-I minutes on 2021-02-22 recorded the tracker as a technical correction, and later Published issue FHIR-25896 clarified the same page to say HL7 Terminology value sets outside core are not listed there.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/terminologies-valuesets.html contains only the core valuesetslist placeholder and explanatory text excluding external HL7 Terminology value sets; publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml keep the page in the current build; no current source or CI-build page hit contains the old v2 value-set tab or wrong prefix anchors.

related_jiras.note: Published later issue for the same terminologies-valuesets.html introductory text; its applied commit clarifies that HL7 Terminology value sets outside core are not listed on the page.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive technical correction asking the R4 Value Sets HL7 V2 tab to use terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2- rather than terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-*/* for value set URIs.
evidence_items.learned: The final issue is in scope, but its own later comment says the problem was no longer relevant once R4B pointed to terminology.hl7.org.

evidence_items.summary: Current source says the page lists core FHIR value sets, excludes HL7 Terminology value sets outside core, and contains only the valuesetslist placeholder.
evidence_items.learned: The old HL7 v2 value-set tab and erroneous prefix are absent from the authoritative current page source.

evidence_items.summary: The Value Sets page is still listed as an active built page under the Terminology module.
evidence_items.learned: The source inspection applies to the current build rather than to a retired or disabled page.

evidence_items.summary: Published same-page clarification applied in 2022 says HL7 Terminology value sets outside the core specification are not listed on the core Value Sets page.
evidence_items.learned: Current wording intentionally avoids presenting THO/v2 value sets on this core page, so the old prefix typo should not be reintroduced or locally patched.
